title: Wild polio cases worldwide, 1988 vs recent

source.name: Global Polio Eradication Initiative case counts

notes: GPEI has reported wild poliovirus paralytic cases falling from about 350,000 across more than 125 countries in 1988 (the year of the global eradication push) to a low double-digit/single-digit count in recent years.
